page.content:
Shirai Ryu specter whose hellfire vendetta defines the series.

How Scorpion connects

  • Faction: Shirai Ryu — Scorpion is the specter of the slaughtered Shirai Ryu.
  • Character: Sub-Zero — Scorpion's vendetta is aimed at the Sub-Zero who killed him.
  • Location: Netherrealm — Scorpion was remade in the Netherrealm after the clan massacre.
  • Work: Mortal Kombat (1992) — Mortal Kombat (1992) introduced Scorpion's spear and hellfire fatality.

What is Scorpion?

Scorpion — Hanzo Hasashi — is the Shirai Ryu ninja murdered by Sub-Zero's Lin Kuei, then returned from the Netherrealm with a spear, a hellfire skull, and a family vendetta.

Key threads lead to Shirai Ryu, Sub-Zero, Netherrealm and Mortal Kombat (1992).
